generation.prompt: Use case: photorealistic architectural concept visualization for a German homeowner project studio. Primary request: one complete residential outdoor project combining a two-car solar carport and an adjacent solar-covered terrace at a modest contemporary house in the Harz region near Seesen, Germany. Scene: realistic flat suburban plot, overcast-bright northern German late-afternoon sky, mature deciduous trees and neighboring roofs, ordinary paved driveway leading to the carport, terrace directly accessible from the house. Subject: restrained dark-anthracite aluminum structures with believable posts, drainage, translucent glass-glass photovoltaic panels on the terrace and opaque photovoltaic roof on the carport, two everyday cars parked underneath. Composition: wide eye-level architectural photo from the street-side garden corner, show the complete carport, complete terrace, house connection, ground contact and roof surfaces in one coherent view; no cropped structure, no floating roofs; sufficient clear space near the upper left for webpage title overlay. Style: photorealistic, premium but buildable and grounded, natural textures, realistic reflections, consistent shadow geometry, no exaggerated luxury resort cues. Constraints: no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no people; show a visual concept only, not engineering drawings.
